name: odoo
title: Mindnow Odoo
description: Mindnow internal Odoo shortcuts (attendance and more)
author: madat

commands.name: attendance
commands.title: Attendance
commands.subtitle: Mindnow Odoo HR check-in / check-out
commands.description: Opens attendance details from Mindnow Odoo. Check in/out or refresh session from the action panel.

commands.name: timesheets
commands.title: Timesheets
commands.subtitle: Mindnow Odoo · browse timesheet lines
commands.description: Lists your timesheet lines from the last 30 days, grouped by date. Refresh or add a line from actions.

commands.name: add-timesheet-line
commands.title: Add Timesheet Line
commands.subtitle: Mindnow Odoo · log time
commands.description: Create a timesheet entry: project, task, date, duration.

preferences.name: email
preferences.title: Email
preferences.description: Login email for your Odoo user

preferences.name: password
preferences.title: Password
preferences.description: Password or API key (Account security → New API Key)

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
